optimizer: AdamW weight_decay=.0003, gradient clip1, per-module relative step cap .005
lr_policy: E166 baseline epoch 15, 3 stalled epochs per drop and E166 early stop; L0 is permanently frozen.
selection: Fixed dev500 own-Loss from a completed S0 epoch, using the E166 L4 exit at 0.10.
training_engine: Deterministic FP32 CUDA Graph for forward/backward and update projection; masked padding for 32-case tail, AdamW outside graphs. Share one selected MST per exit; deterministic matrix sum for selected endpoint gradients.
cache_policy: Read-only reuse of the original compatible full shared CPU static and public-role caches.

soft_count_proxy.aggregation: Per-case original no-MIB soft-constraint capacity; MST edge contact gap and worst required boundary-side gap per block

active_layers: L0 (frozen), L1-L4 (S0 and its public problem encoder)
